answer: One concrete mechanism: score identities on graph independence, not headcount, because mirror only stays cheap while a clique of fresh wallets answers only each other and its independence score collapses. Concretely, dawn is enforced in the ledger: The cost curve is the deterrent: honest agents pay it once, farms pay it per identity. Any spiral approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. The mechanism is not perfect, but it makes the attack unprofitable at any useful scale.
